evidence.title: Industrial Production: Total Index
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was -0.62 percent; it resolved to 'below recent range'.

evidence.title: US industrial production data jumps sharply in August - The Business Times
evidence.summary: This source provides the US industrial production data for August 2024, showing a sharp increase of 0.8% after a decline in July. It highlights the recovery in motor vehicles and parts as a key driver. This is a direct measure of industrial production leading into September.

evidence.title: The ISM Manufacturing Index Increased to 47.2 in August
evidence.summary: This source reports on the ISM Manufacturing Index for August 2024, which increased to 47.2 but still indicates contraction (below 50). It notes worrisome details like a drop in new orders, suggesting underlying weakness in the manufacturing sector that could impact September's industrial production.

evidence.title: US Manufacturing Activity Contracts for a Fifth Straight Month | Financial Post
evidence.summary: This source indicates that US manufacturing activity contracted for the fifth consecutive month in August 2024. This sustained contraction suggests a challenging environment for industrial production, potentially leading to a negative growth rate in September.

evidence.title: Press Release: Industrial Production Index (IPI). August 2024. Provisional data.
evidence.summary: While this source is for Spain's Industrial Production Index, it provides a global context for industrial activity in August 2024. It shows a monthly change of -0.1% for Spain, which could indicate broader trends or headwinds in global industrial production that might influence the US.

evidence.title: US Sector PMI ® indices are compiled from responses to questionnaires sent to purchasing managers in S&P Global's US manufacturing and services PMI survey panels, covering over 1,000 private sector companies.
evidence.summary: This source details US Sector PMI data for August 2024, indicating that manufacturing performance was generally much weaker than services activity, with Basic Materials and Consumer Goods sectors signaling a reduction in output. This suggests a challenging environment for manufacturing that could extend into September.
